screening_decisions.reason: RCT comparing LMWH (nadroparin) to placebo in ambulatory cancer patients receiving chemotherapy for primary VTE prophylaxis. Meets all selection criteria.
RCT comparing dalteparin (LMWH) added to chemotherapy vs chemotherapy alone in SCLC patients. Prophylactic dose used. Meets criteria for anticoagulant vs no anticoagulant comparison.
RCT comparing warfarin plus chemotherapy vs chemotherapy alone in SCLC patients. Oral anticoagulant vs no anticoagulant comparison meets criteria.
RCT comparing enoxaparin (supraprophylactic dose) to standard treatment alone in SCLC patients. Meets criteria for anticoagulant vs no anticoagulant.

No control group - all patients received dalteparin at different doses. Abstract states 'lack of control group precluded any inference'. Does not meet criteria for comparison to no thromboprophylaxis or placebo.
Pediatric population (age 1-18 years) with ALL receiving induction therapy. Not ambulatory adult cancer patients receiving chemotherapy as specified in review scope.
RCT comparing certoparin (LMWH) to placebo in ambulatory patients with metastatic breast or lung cancer. Primary VTE prophylaxis. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing dalteparin to placebo in patients with advanced malignancy. Although primary outcome was survival, it compares anticoagulant to placebo in cancer patients.
RCT comparing dalteparin to observation in ambulatory cancer patients at high risk for VTE starting systemic therapy. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing nadroparin to placebo in patients with metastasized or locally advanced solid tumors. Compares anticoagulant to placebo.
RCT comparing aspirin to enoxaparin (two different anticoagulants) in MM patients receiving lenalidomide. Meets criteria for comparing two anticoagulants.
RCT comparing subcutaneous heparin to no heparin in SCLC patients receiving chemotherapy. Meets criteria for anticoagulant vs no anticoagulant.
RCT comparing bemiparin (LMWH) to no bemiparin in SCLC patients receiving chemoradiotherapy. Meets criteria.
RCT comparing very-low-dose warfarin to placebo in women with metastatic breast cancer receiving chemotherapy. Oral anticoagulant vs placebo. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing apixaban (DOAC) to placebo in cancer patients receiving chemotherapy. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing LMWH to no LMWH in lung cancer patients. Primary prophylaxis dose. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing dalteparin added to gemcitabine vs gemcitabine alone in pancreatic cancer patients. Meets criteria.
RCT comparing warfarin to no warfarin in SCLC patients receiving chemotherapy and radiation. Meets criteria.
Pediatric population with ALL. Not within scope of ambulatory adult cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.
RCT comparing aspirin, warfarin, and enoxaparin (three different anticoagulants) in MM patients receiving thalidomide. Meets criteria for comparing different anticoagulants.
RCT comparing enoxaparin to observation in ambulatory patients with advanced pancreatic cancer receiving chemotherapy. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing dalteparin to placebo in patients with malignant glioma. While glioma patients may not always receive chemotherapy, some do (temozolomide). Conservative inclusion.
RCT comparing LMWH to standard care alone in patients with advanced cancer. Meets criteria for anticoagulant vs no anticoagulant.
RCT comparing nadroparin to no nadroparin in patients with NSCLC, prostate, or pancreatic cancer. Meets criteria.
RCT comparing warfarin to no warfarin in SCLC patients receiving chemotherapy and radiation. Meets criteria.
RCT comparing enoxaparin to observation in advanced cancer patients stratified by TFMP levels. Meets criteria.
RCT comparing semuloparin (ultra-LMWH) to placebo in patients receiving chemotherapy for cancer. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing apixaban to placebo in ambulatory cancer patients at intermediate-to-high risk starting chemotherapy. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing rivaroxaban to placebo in high-risk ambulatory cancer patients. Meets all criteria.
Appears to be additional analysis/subset of Study 16 (FRAGMATIC trial), not a distinct RCT. Duplicate reporting.
Adjuvant setting in completely resected NSCLC (stage I-IIIA), not primary prophylaxis during chemotherapy. Wrong setting.
Phase 2 trial with three groups including historical controls, not a proper concurrent RCT design. Groups were generated sequentially.
Unclear randomization - appears to be observational comparison of vena cava filter placement vs conservative therapy. Not clearly an RCT.
Adjuvant setting post-surgery in resected NSCLC, not primary prophylaxis during active chemotherapy. Wrong setting.
Subgroup analysis of a broader medical patient trial, not a primary cancer trial. Cannot isolate cancer-specific effects.
Postoperative surgical setting with mixed cancer and non-cancer populations. Not ambulatory cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.
Observational study comparing groups based on practice patterns, not randomized. States 'observational study' in title.
Pediatric population with ALL. Also described as 'prospective cohort study' not RCT.
Descriptive report of three series, not a randomized controlled trial. No randomization mentioned.
Economic evaluation/cost analysis of trial data, not a primary RCT. Secondary analysis.
